Silverline.SL_PolicyDef.label: Acts of Storyteller Excluded
Silverline.SL_PolicyDef.description: Pays for buildings destroyed by raiders, mechanoids and the occasional misunderstanding with a siege engine. Not valid for fires, weather or you.
Silverline.SL_PolicyDef.coversText: Buildings of your colony that are destroyed by enemy hands (raids, sieges, mechanoids). Not fire, not storms, not your own turrets.
Silverline.SL_PolicyDef.benefitBare: Cash for the destroyed building, after your own share.
Silverline.SL_PolicyDef.benefitGood: Cash, or the building materials delivered by capsule.
Silverline.SL_PolicyDef.benefitPremium: Replacement value, paid instantly by capsule. Goodwill once a year.

li.label: Wear-and-tear waiver
li.description: Pays 10 % more of every loss (never more than the loss itself).

li.label: Express paperwork
li.description: The claims department looks at your claim one day sooner.

Silverline.SL_PolicyDef.label: Muffalo & Machine Cover
Silverline.SL_PolicyDef.description: For things that move or fly: shuttles, drop pods and vehicles that are destroyed by an enemy.
Silverline.SL_PolicyDef.slogan: Wheels, rotors and a very thorough form.
Silverline.SL_PolicyDef.coversText: Shuttles, drop pods and vehicles destroyed by hostile forces. Bionic parts are equipment and are, in principle, also meant to be here. In practice: see the Accident Plan.
Silverline.SL_PolicyDef.benefitBare: Repair money, half of the time value.
Silverline.SL_PolicyDef.benefitGood: Cash or parts by capsule, 80 % of the time value.
Silverline.SL_PolicyDef.benefitPremium: Replacement value, instantly. The tow drone is yours.

li.label: Wear-and-tear waiver
li.description: Pays 10 % more of every loss (never more than the loss itself).

Silverline.SL_PolicyDef.label: Roof Over Your Head
Silverline.SL_PolicyDef.description: Fire, explosions and lightning. The fire has to be somebody else's, though.
Silverline.SL_PolicyDef.slogan: Warm walls, cold comfort, quarterly premiums.
Silverline.SL_PolicyDef.coversText: Buildings of your colony destroyed by fire, explosions and storms. Fires and blasts started by your own people are excluded (§11).
Silverline.SL_PolicyDef.benefitBare: Cash for the burnt building, after your own share.
Silverline.SL_PolicyDef.benefitGood: Cash, or building materials by capsule.
Silverline.SL_PolicyDef.benefitPremium: Replacement value, instantly by capsule. Ashes not included.

li.label: Wear-and-tear waiver
li.description: Pays 10 % more of every loss (never more than the loss itself).

li.label: Express paperwork
li.description: The claims department looks at your claim one day sooner.

Silverline.SL_PolicyDef.label: It Wasn't Me Liability
Silverline.SL_PolicyDef.description: For damage to guests, traders and their goods, caused in your care and definitely not by you.
Silverline.SL_PolicyDef.slogan: Somebody has to pay. Preferably us, for a fee.
Silverline.SL_PolicyDef.coversText: Damage to guests and to traders' goods for which your colony is liable. Reported by the inn, the market and the trade desk.
Silverline.SL_PolicyDef.benefitBare: Half of the compensation, paid to the injured party's faction.
Silverline.SL_PolicyDef.benefitGood: 80 % of the compensation. Goodwill loss halved.
Silverline.SL_PolicyDef.benefitPremium: All of it. The rumour is also taken care of.

li.label: Express paperwork
li.description: The claims department looks at your claim one day sooner.

Silverline.SL_PolicyDef.label: Legal Shield
Silverline.SL_PolicyDef.description: Kanzlei Brix & Partners pay your fines and argue with the people who issued them. Also helps against Clawback Mutual, as long as nobody reads clause 40.
Silverline.SL_PolicyDef.coversText: Fines and penalties of inspectors, licence trouble and collection disputes. Also lowers the chance that Clawback Mutual denies your claims, and fixes your cancellation forms.
Silverline.SL_PolicyDef.benefitGood: 80 % of every fine, and an appeal is lodged.
Silverline.SL_PolicyDef.benefitPremium: The whole fine. Advocate Brix reads your forms before you do.

li.label: Express paperwork
li.description: The claims department looks at your claim one day sooner.

Silverline.SL_PolicyDef.label: Rim Health Plan
Silverline.SL_PolicyDef.description: A flat sum for every colonist who spends a day in a sickbed.
Silverline.SL_PolicyDef.slogan: Get well soon. Or at least get well quarterly.
Silverline.SL_PolicyDef.coversText: Every day a colonist is bedridden with an illness or an injury that needs treatment. Food poisoning is an accident of cooking and counts anyway.
Silverline.SL_PolicyDef.benefitBare: 10 silver per bedridden colonist and day.
Silverline.SL_PolicyDef.benefitGood: 15 silver per bedridden colonist and day.
Silverline.SL_PolicyDef.benefitPremium: 25 silver per bedridden colonist and day. The second opinion is free.

li.label: Hospital hospitality
li.description: Pays 10 % more on every sickbed day.

Silverline.SL_PolicyDef.label: Golden Years Plan
Silverline.SL_PolicyDef.description: A pension for colonists who made it to sixty. The premium is cheap while they are young, which is the point.
Silverline.SL_PolicyDef.slogan: Retire early. Then late. Then quarterly.
Silverline.SL_PolicyDef.coversText: One colonist. From the age of 60 Clawback Mutual pays a daily pension (Bare Minimum: a single lump sum).
Silverline.SL_PolicyDef.benefitBare: The sum insured, once, when the colonist turns 60.
Silverline.SL_PolicyDef.benefitGood: 0.4 % of the sum insured per day, from 60.
Silverline.SL_PolicyDef.benefitPremium: 0.6 % of the sum insured per day, from 60. A retirement party is thinkable.

Silverline.SL_PolicyDef.label: Blight Be Gone
Silverline.SL_PolicyDef.description: Cold snaps and toxic fallout eat crops. This eats the loss.
Silverline.SL_PolicyDef.coversText: Your crops in a cold snap or toxic fallout.
Silverline.SL_PolicyDef.benefitBare: Cash for the lost harvest, after your own share.
Silverline.SL_PolicyDef.benefitPremium: Full value of the harvest, instantly.

li.label: Wear-and-tear waiver
li.description: Pays 10 % more of every loss (never more than the loss itself).

Silverline.SL_PolicyDef.label: Closed for Repairs
Silverline.SL_PolicyDef.description: When your business has to close, the income does not.
Silverline.SL_PolicyDef.slogan: Out of order is not out of premium.
Silverline.SL_PolicyDef.coversText: Lost income after a closure of your venue, reported by the businesses of Hearth & Harbor.
Silverline.SL_PolicyDef.benefitBare: A flat day, whatever the day was worth.
Silverline.SL_PolicyDef.benefitGood: The average daily loss, up to five days.
Silverline.SL_PolicyDef.benefitPremium: Daily loss for up to 15 days.

Silverline.SL_PolicyDef.label: Unspeakable Events Rider
Silverline.SL_PolicyDef.description: For damage the policy wording cannot describe without a lawyer in the room.
Silverline.SL_PolicyDef.slogan: Some things are better insured than named.
Silverline.SL_PolicyDef.benefitBare: Cash, after your own share. Please do not describe the entity.
Silverline.SL_PolicyDef.benefitPremium: Replacement value, instantly. A specialist is on the phone.

Silverline.SL_PolicyDef.label: Wanderlust Travel Cover
Silverline.SL_PolicyDef.description: For caravans: an insurance that is there when you are not. Billed by the head and the travel day, only while people are on the road.
Silverline.SL_PolicyDef.slogan: Wish you were here. We'll cover the part where you are not.
Silverline.SL_PolicyDef.coversText: Colonists on caravans. Bare Minimum pays only a death, Good Enough also lost body parts, Premium every scratch.
Silverline.SL_PolicyDef.benefitBare: The sum per head, only if somebody dies on the road.
Silverline.SL_PolicyDef.benefitGood: Death, and lost body parts by the Schedule of Limbs.
Silverline.SL_PolicyDef.benefitPremium: Everything above, and a flat sum for every single injury.

Silverline.SL_PolicyDef.label: Limb by Limb Accident Plan
Silverline.SL_PolicyDef.description: Every limb has a price. We wrote it down. It is on the last page, in the Schedule of Limbs.
Silverline.SL_PolicyDef.slogan: Every limb has a price. We wrote it down.
Silverline.SL_PolicyDef.coversText: One colonist. Permanent consequences of accidents by the Schedule of Limbs, and accidental death (20 % of the sum). Assessed one quadrum after the accident. Operations are not accidents.
Silverline.SL_PolicyDef.benefitBare: Linear by the Schedule of Limbs, from 20 % invalidity. Partial losses are not paid.
Silverline.SL_PolicyDef.benefitGood: 225 % progression from 5 % invalidity. Partial losses are paid.
Silverline.SL_PolicyDef.benefitPremium: 350 % progression from 1 % invalidity. Every finger has a price.

li.label: Progression Plus (500 %)
li.description: Premium accidents pay on the 500 % table instead of 350 %. Only matters for the big ones.

li.label: Death benefit boost
li.description: The accidental death sum rises from 20 % to 30 % of the basic sum.
